SNIC Cement: Apparent Consumption and Production

Source: R/data-cement.R
cement.Rd

Monthly cement apparent consumption and production in Brazil by state and region.

Retrieve this dataset with get_dataset() using the name "cement".

cement <- get_dataset("cement")
cement_production <- get_dataset("cement", table = "production")

Source

SNIC - Sindicato Nacional da Indústria do Cimento

Details

  • Source: SNIC - Sindicato Nacional da Indústria do Cimento

  • URL: https://snic.org.br/numeros-da-industria.php

  • Geography: Brazil, five regions, 27 states, and unattributed regional adjustments

  • Frequency: monthly

  • Coverage: 2003-present; state observations are missing from 2014-03 through 2016-12

  • Access mode: materialized

  • Tables: "consumption", "production" (default: "consumption")

Ajustes are regional estimates not attributed to states. State values are missing from March 2014 through December 2016, although region and Brazil totals remain. Across this gap, state comparisons are uncertain because the unattributed Ajustes share rose from about 5% to about 13% of Brazil consumption. Preliminary values are subject to revision. The archive and PDFs have no stated redistribution licence; snapshots must not be published until rights are cleared.

Columns

All tables share the structure below; the table argument filters which series are returned.

date

First day of the reference month.

geography_type

State, adjustment, region, or Brazil row; totals must not be summed with their components.

code_region

IBGE major-region code; missing for Brazil.

abbrev_state

Two-letter state abbreviation; missing for other geography types.

code_state

IBGE state code; missing for other geography types.

value

Cement quantity in tonnes; NA means unavailable or not yet published.

unit

Constant tonnes.

source_kind

Archive through 2023 or SNIC regional PDF from 2024.

get_dataset(), query_dataset(), list_datasets(), get_dataset_info()
